sentences.text: Breagyps is an extinct genus of New World vulture belonging to the family Cathartidae, containing only one known species, Breagyps clarki.
The genus name honors the La Brea Tar Pits in California, the site where its fossils were discovered.
This animal lived from the Chibanian to the Late Pleistocene, between 0.21 and 0.0117 million years ago.
